parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application group ID. You can obtain the ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 list-workflow-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --workflow-id 123 --region cn-hangzhou
